data.name: Jerusha
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word ‘yarah’, which means ‘to see, to show, to cast a glance’. The name Jerusha is interpreted as ‘the Lord will see’ or ‘the Lord will cast a glance’. This name is often associated with God’s condescension and His care for His people, as seen in the Old Testament when Jerusha, the wife of Barak, is promised a son by the prophet Deborah. The name Jerusha is also used for a refugee city or place of refuge in the Bible, reminding us of God’s protection and care for His people.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's care and protection for His people.

In religious art, Jerusha is often depicted as a shield or a fortified city, symbolizing God’s protection and care for His people.
